params.prompt:
SHOT: Extreme macro, 4:5, of ONLY THREE HEARTS from the middle of the row, seen very close so they fill most of the frame: a polished silver tone heart, a gold tone heart paved with tiny clear stones and a polished silver tone heart, threaded on the chain; the chain is the SAME FLAT ribbon snake chain as IMAGE 1: a flat, smooth, bright silver band about a third of a heart's width, with very fine ribbing across it, never a round chain, never coarse rounded scales; the rest of the necklace is out of frame, far closer than IMAGE 1, resting on the top face of a cream plaster cube. Camera very close; the piece fills about two thirds of the frame; razor-sharp on the stones and the metal edges, the rest falling softly out of focus.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved packshot of this exact piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, proportions, metal colour and stone colour EXACTLY; ignore its cube and its background. IMAGE 1 is a close view, so the piece's SIZE in this picture comes ONLY from the SCALE TEST below. IMAGE 2 is the authority for the plaster, the background and the light only.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A TWO-TONE HEART NECKLACE: a flat, smooth, bright SILVER TONE snake chain about 3mm wide, threaded at the front with ELEVEN small puffed HEART beads in one row, alternating: a polished plain silver tone heart, then a gold tone heart covered in tiny clear pave stones, then silver again, and so on, starting and ending with silver (six silver hearts, five gold pave hearts). All hearts point down and touch each other. Exactly eleven hearts, alternating silver and gold pave, never all gold, never all silver; the chain is a flat silver snake chain, never a cable or rope chain, never gold; no pendant. Counted from one end the hearts run silver, gold, silver, gold, silver, gold, silver, gold, silver, gold, silver: never two silver hearts side by side, never two gold.

SCALE TEST: Each heart is about 7mm across; the row of hearts is about 8cm wide; the chain is about 3mm wide.

LIGHT: Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no ear, no model, no fabric, no props. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: polished gold tone and bright silver tone exactly where IMAGE 1 shows them. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. The picture runs edge to edge as a crisp, clean, modern digital studio photograph, shot today on a high-resolution digital camera.
